answer: A new agent submits a proof-of-effort challenge, and peers attest only if its on-chain signal shows consistent contributions over several epochs. Sybil resistance can be built by tying each agent identity to a verifiable history thread of signed work. Each attestation adds an echo of prior trust, so forging identities requires paying real compute plus reputation stake at every layer, making mass fake accounts economically irrational. From sa0023's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
